wikitext: {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PG04 | prevtitle=The Lake of Rage | nextcode=PG06 | nexttitle=The Reawakening | series=Pokémon Generations | colorscheme=Hoso}} {{EpisodeInfobox| epcode=PG05 | colorscheme=Hoso| title_en=The Legacy | title_ja=継承 | title_ja_trans=The Succession | release_method=Web release | screen=hd | broadcast_jp=December 9, 2016| broadcast_us=October 7, 2016 | en_op=N/A | ja_op=N/A | ja_ed=N/A | olmteam=Team Kato | scenario=冨岡淳広 | storyboard=柳沼和良 | director=柳沼和良 | artn=2 | art1=山田史 | art2=末澤慧 | morecredits=no | epstaffpage=PG01-PG10 | footnotes=* ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=19T-UN3igrQ The Legacy]'' on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * {{BMGf|218977|Review thread on BMGf}} }} '''The Legacy''' (Japanese: '''継承''' ''The Succession'') is the fifth episode of [[Pokémon Generations]]. It was first released on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on October 7, 2016. It was uploaded to the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on December 9, 2016. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== In the wake of Team Rocket’s takeover of the Goldenrod Radio Tower, Detective Looker’s investigation leads him to an enigmatic young Trainer. ==Plot== As the sun is setting over the [[Kanto]] [[region]], {{ga|Silver}} is seen walking down a road alone, until he's confronted by [[Looker]]. Silver walks right past Looker, but Looker halts him. Silver asks what he wants and Looker explains he is from the [[International Police]]. He asks Silver if he is the son of the [[Team Rocket]] Boss [[Giovanni]], to which Silver angrily replies he wants to be left out of whatever Looker wants to discuss with him. Looker continues by telling Silver there was an incident in [[Goldenrod City]]. Remnants of Team Rocket took over the [[Goldenrod Radio Tower]] and used the radio equipment to announce their return to the people of [[Johto]] after lying dormant for three years and pleade Giovanni to rejoin them, but Giovanni never showed up to lead and unify them, causing the entire event to fall flat. Looker tells Silver that he believes that Giovanni is still out hiding somewhere, plotting his return and that's why he needs Silver's help. Silver complies and starts telling Looker that he also saw his father for the last time three years ago. After returning to the [[Viridian Gym]] but losing to {{ga|Blue|two}} {{ga|Red|Trainers}}, Giovanni [[PG02|decided to leave Viridian City]]. Right before leaving, Silver confronted him, not understanding why his father wanted to run away. Giovanni replied that one cannot move forward if they are unable to accept defeat, and in order to make Team Rocket stronger, Giovanni needed some time alone. He had realized he had failed to utilize his {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt|men}}'s fullest potential and vowed that one day, he would revive Team Rocket as a much stronger team. Silver told his father he still didn't understand him, declaring that he would never want to be like Giovanni and would become strong on his own. After this, Silver ran away. Silver tells Looker that was the very last time he saw Giovanni and that he managed to make things on his own since then. He turns around and faces the [[Indigo Plateau|Pokémon League]] building. Looker now understands that Silver is going to challenge the [[Elite Four]], and asks him to give him a call if he finds out anything about his father. Silver doesn't promise this to Looker, having made the choice to stay out of his father's affairs. He proceeds to tell him that it is Looker's job to find him, as he walks up the stairs to the Pokémon League building. ==Major events== * [[Looker]] meets up with {{ga|Silver}} and questions him for information about [[Giovanni]]. * Looker describes [[Team Rocket]]'s takeover of the [[Goldenrod Radio Tower]] to Silver. * Silver tells Looker about his last encounter with Giovanni three years earlier. * Silver prepares to challenge the [[Indigo Plateau|Pokémon League]]. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{ga|Silver}} * [[Looker]] * [[Giovanni]] (flashback) * {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s (flashback) * {{wp|SWAT}} officers (flashback) * Citizens of [[Goldenrod City]] (flashback) * {{FB|Goldenrod|Radio Tower}} crew (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Arbok}} ({{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Koffing}} ({{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Zubat}} ({{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Fearow}} ==Trivia== * The conversation between {{ga|Silver}} and [[Giovanni]] is the same one they had at {{rt|22|Kanto}} during the {{p|Celebi}} event in {{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}}. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FDBB99|bordercolor=FD7F4F |nl={{tt|De nalatenschap|The legacy}} |fr_eu={{tt|L’héritage|The Legacy}} |de={{tt|Das Erbe|The Legacy}} |it={{tt|L'eredità|The Legacy}} |ko={{tt|계승|The Succession}} |pt_br={{tt|O Legado|The Legacy}} |es_eu={{tt|El legado|The legacy}} }} {{-}} {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PG04 | prevtitle=The Lake of Rage | nextcode=PG06 | nexttitle=The Reawakening | series=Pokémon Generations | colorscheme=Hoso}} {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Pokémon Generations episodes|05]] [[Category:Episodes written by Atsuhiro Tomioka]] [[Category:Episodes storyboarded and directed by Kazuyoshi Yaginuma]] [[Category:Episodes storyboarded by Kazuyoshi Yaginuma]] [[Category:Episodes directed by Kazuyoshi Yaginuma]] [[Category:Episodes animated by Kei Suezawa]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time animation directors]] [[Category:Episodes by multiple animation directors]] [[Category:Episodes which aired in the United States before Japan]] [[de:Pokémon Generationen Folge 5: Das Erbe]] [[es:GEN05]] [[fr:PG05]] [[it:PG05]] [[ja:PG第5話]] [[zh:宝可梦世代 第5集]]
